subject.title: fix(workboard): avoid duplicate proof entries on completion

question: Should Workboard add a durable correlation mechanism for pending proof and completion, or keep proof append-only until that contract is designed?
rationale: The requested deduplication changes persisted proof-history semantics, and content equality alone is not a reliable ownership boundary across retries.

options.title: Add explicit run correlation
options.body: Introduce a narrowly defined correlation between the pending proof and its completion result, with retry-history regression coverage.

options.title: Keep proof append-only
options.body: Defer deduplication and retain separate proof entries until a safe persisted correlation contract is available.

recommendation.title: Add explicit run correlation
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrowly defined correlation between the pending proof and its completion result, with retry-history regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the linked production context and the proposed Workboard lifecycle behavior.
